    platform: linux2404-64/opt
    worker-type: t-linux-docker-amd

        docker-image: {in-tree: "lint"}
        max-run-time: 1800
        # Uncomment to upload logs of the generations as artifacts.

        artifacts:
            - type: directory
              name: public/taskgraph
              path: /builds/worker/artifacts
